as_told.title: Kit Green confronts Eric Walker at Penn State about crashed saucers

plain: This story is about a man named Kit Green and his visit to Eric Walker, described as a former president of Penn State, a university in the United States. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a run-in between the two. A researcher, Grant Cameron, gives more detail, drawing on the published diaries of the author Jacques Vallee, called Forbidden Science. According to Cameron, this happened in the 1980s, and when Green asked about secret UFO matters, Walker blew up and started yelling. Cameron says Walker shouted that he did not have to tell him anything, and Green was thrown out. The story matters because Walker is said by others to have known about a secret UFO group, and his anger is read as a sign there was something to hide.
